description: This file defines a React component 'GraphD3' which renders a force-directed adjacency graph using D3.js. The component visualizes role nodes and their relationships, colors nodes based on readiness from gap analysis, and includes interactive features like node selection and filtering. It also handles layout initialization and simulation, styling, and user interaction.

methods.name: GraphD3
methods.description: React functional component that renders a force-directed graph of roles, with configurable nodes, edges, layout, and interactivity.
